description: Is an IP address or a domain on a blocklist? Give `indicator` (an IPv4/IPv6 address or a domain; a URL is reduced to its host). Answers `listed`, a rough 0-100 `score` with the `reasons` behind it, the nichedb /traffic record (addresses our own servers banned and a person approved), the abuse.ch indicators (ThreatFox, URLhaus, Feodo Tracker; a domain is checked with its parent domains), the SURBL standing of a watched domain, and live DNS blocklists in `dnsbl` (an address: Spamhaus ZEN with SBL/CSS/XBL/PBL decoded, SpamCop, PSBL, Mailspike; a domain and its parents: Spamhaus DBL, URIBL, SURBL). A domain is also resolved and each A/AAAA address is checked the same way, in `addresses` (each with `ip`, `listed`, `traffic`, `indicators`, `dnsbl`). A list whose own test entry failed is named in `unknown`, not treated as a miss. Not listed is not the same as clean.

indicator.description: An IP address or a domain, e.g. 203.0.113.9 or evil.example

name: reputation_lookup
